penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Setting up meaningful Salesforce org change-tracking, collision detection, and audit tooling requires per-customer Salesforce org access, configuration, and ongoing integration maintenance — not automatable by Claude prompts alone.

rationale: The pain is real and recurring — small Salesforce dev teams regularly lose work from uncoordinated deployments — and the buyer (a dev team at an agency or SMB ISV) has budget (they're paying for Salesforce). However, building a meaningful Salesforce change-tracking or org-lock layer requires deep Salesforce API integration, Metadata API knowledge, and per-customer org configuration that cannot be delivered autonomously by Claude. Enterprise alternatives (Gearset, Copado) already exist, and the gap is in price/simplicity, not in the problem being unsolved. Total collapses below validate after the required-human-fulfillment penalty.
solution_plan: This is not buildable as a Claude-first micro-service without substantial custom Salesforce integration engineering. The solution requires Salesforce Metadata API access, org authentication per customer, and real-time deployment hooks — none of which Claude + a Stripe link can deliver. A solo non-technical operator cannot build or maintain this without a Salesforce developer. Pass.
notes: operational_autonomy score of 4 fails the build gate (min: 7). buildability_with_ai score of 4 fails the build gate (min: 6). Total below validate threshold of 5.5 after penalties.
